sources.title: File an Appeal — Arkansas Department of Human Services

slice.from: Home > Contact Us > File an Appeal

sources.notes: Recipe written 2026-11-05 for tools/packets/arkansas-packet-dhs.txt, which had none, so no pass could re-fetch it (pass-health finding, 2026-11-05 nightly run). Transport is chrome because the supplement's capture notes record that humanservices.arkansas.gov returns a bare nginx 403 to curl on every path tried, over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, with and without a browser user-agent, Accept and Accept-Language headers, and that the session's web-fetch tool returned the site's navigation menus twice and none of the page body; a browser rendering was the only transport that produced the page. Extractor none, as the capture was document.body.innerText. The slice anchors are the ones that capture already used: the breadcrumb line down to the footer's 'Learn About Programs'. The supplement is carried for the Office of Appeals and Hearings' address and email only — the page nowhere mentions nursing facilities, transfers or discharges, and says so itself. This records the method and makes it executable by a session with a browser; it does not make the source re-verifiable by the unattended pass, which the packet's capture notes state and which stays true.
